changeSet.author: nelson
changeSet.comment: Set a lone undisbursed tranche to remaining approved principal when it was left at the applied amount
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan_disbursement_detail dd INNER JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = dd.loan_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT loan_id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail WHERE disbursedon_date IS NULL GROUP BY loan_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ) single_open ON single_open.loan_id = dd.loan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT loan_id, COALESCE(SUM(principal), 0) AS disbursed_principal FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail WHERE disbursedon_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loan_id ) paid ON paid.loan_id = dd.loan_id SET dd.principal = GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0), dd.net_disbursal_amount = GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0) WHERE dd.disbursedon_date IS NULL AND l.approved_principal IS NOT NULL AND l.loan_status_id IN (200, 300) AND dd.principal IS NOT NULL AND dd.principal <> GREATEST(COALESCE(l.approved_principal, 0) - COALESCE(paid.disbursed_principal, 0), 0)

changeSet.author: nelson
changeSet.comment: Keep single-tranche net_disbursal_amount as approved principal minus charges due at disbursement
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan_disbursement_detail dd INNER JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = dd.loan_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT loan_id FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail GROUP BY loan_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN disbursedon_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 AND COUNT(*) = 1 ) single_detail ON single_detail.loan_id = dd.loan_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT loan_id, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS charge_amount FROM m_loan_charge WHERE is_active = 1 AND is_paid_derived = 0 AND waived = 0 AND charge_time_enum IN (1, 12) GROUP BY loan_id ) charges ON charges.loan_id = dd.loan_id SET dd.net_disbursal_amount = GREATEST(dd.principal - COALESCE(charges.charge_amount, 0), 0) WHERE dd.disbursedon_date IS NULL AND l.loan_status_id IN (200, 300) AND dd.principal IS NOT NULL AND (dd.net_disbursal_amount IS NULL OR dd.net_disbursal_amount <> GREATEST(dd.principal - COALESCE(charges.charge_amount, 0), 0))
